releaseNotes: Refreshes the offline cache again so all installed Chrome copies load the corrected 13-system Nelson list.
Restores Nelson Urology as the 13th medical system, showing its 14 questions instead of leaving them out of the system list.
Rotates the Chrome offline cache so previously installed copies stop serving stale Pediatrics scripts and receive the current Nelson bank UI.
Refreshes the Nelson collection UI and offline content manifest so installed Chrome copies can receive the latest verified files.
Adds a dedicated Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics cover image and removes the empty topic label from Nelson's system-only question cards.
Fixes Nelson questions not appearing when the selected study grade does not include Pediatrics; Nelson remains accessible across grades.
Removes Nelson review-status tags and flagged counters while preserving safeguards for incomplete questions; removes the Study Hub panel from Home.
Adds the separate Nelson Textbook Pediatrics question collection from the curated Markdown files in Nelson.zip, including Core, Extended, Accepted and Review material.
Nelson questions are grouped by medical system only; selecting a system opens its questions directly, reusing existing system icons.
Nelson explanations show an initial beginner-friendly explanation and an expandable Read More section, with the Nelson source at the end of the expanded explanation.
Incomplete OCR questions remain flagged and answer selection is disabled when the stem or options are incomplete.
Continues the independent unified Chrome PWA for phone and computer. Android APK, iOS and Computer deliveries remain separate.
Smart Review opens directly at Your Session; Smart Recommended remains available as a compact action within the session panel.
Overview keeps its statistics, topic mastery map and mastery journey while removing the due-today / 20-question hero card only.
Empty Schedule state no longer displays the redundant Choose a topic button.
Pediatrics Start Studying opens the collection chooser first. The doctor MCQ bank and Previous Questions remain separate and are grouped by their existing system/topic mapping.
The side menu keeps the existing Exam Goal Planner under Your Progress and removes the duplicate extension entry.
Question bank records, stable question IDs, question wording, option labels, answer keys and explanations are preserved.
Fixes offline installation integrity retries by bypassing stale Service Worker cache responses for hash-versioned verification requests, while storing verified bytes under canonical local cache URLs.

Offline retry reuses the previously saved package cache, rechecks existing files against the current byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and downloads only missing or changed assets. The latest Service Worker is checked and activated before integrity downloads.
After the complete current package passes integrity verification, obsolete cache entries and older package caches are deleted. Existing answers, bookmarks, notes and study progress remain preserved.
Pediatrics collection navigation now renders the registered collection chooser correctly from Start Studying, with the doctor MCQ and Previous Questions paths available.
Removed the Smart Recommended card and its Start recommended action entirely from Smart Review, as requested.

Reworked Pediatrics Start Studying to use the existing Pediatrics specialties route and collection chooser; removed the unsupported custom page registration shim that could leave the Start action unresponsive.
Pediatrics 'Start Studying' and 'Continue Studying' now work: the collection and home scripts are connected to the app core through a safe bridge (no data or markup changes).
Added a Question bank selector (All banks / Dr. Al-Joaki / Previous) to Quiz, Search and Smart Review. It is a view-only filter; question records, IDs, answer keys and explanations are unchanged.
A question opened from Search, Saved, Wrong answers or Smart Review now opens inside its own bank, so a Previous question no longer opens as an empty list.
